paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: Different Audio-Language models’ performance on MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance of different audio-language models on two metrics, MMAU and MMAR. The horizontal axis contains the model names, listed in the order of Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, with no apparent scale or ordering. The vertical axis represents the accuracy as a percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, marked with tick labels at intervals of 10. The chart features two sets of bars, one for MMAU, represented in blue, and the other for MMAR, represented in purple. The MMAU bars have approximate values of 50, 60, and 65 for the three models, respectively. The MMAR bars have approximate values of 30, 35, and 55 for the three models, respectively. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color representation.
